seeds: no new random numbers: deterministic quadrature, plus read-only post-processing of the stored scout FK ensembles (their seeds 11-16 are recorded in fk_npz_used)

meanfield_to_exact_shift_ratio.definition: S_* u0(lam) / (rho y*(lam)) over the lam>0 grid

fk_height_summary.smoothing_rule: scout analyze_fk.py: FK density smoothed by a discrete Gaussian of sd h_steps*dt, h_steps = max(1, 0.15 eps S_*/(v_max dt)) (0.15 x narrowest bump sd); matching limit = hatp_lam * phi_theta_eff with theta_eff^2 = theta^2 + (v h_steps dt/(eps rho))^2

fk_height_convergence.definition: FK smoothed peak height / smoothing-matched limit height - 1, per (m, j, B) at eps = 0.1, 0.05, 0.035

fk_mode_counts_summary.rule: count of local maxima of the smoothed FK density with z > 5 (scout analyze_fk.py count_modes)

fk_gate_diagnostics_summary.basin_mass_diff_note: B in {1, 8}, m in {2, 3}; exact basin masses of the stored FK ensembles, gated ('full') vs gate-free ('free')

gate_transfer_anchor.cov_note: ||Cov Y_t|| = largest eigenvalue; A_eps uses M_Y = sup_[0,T]|Y|, so the relevant supremum is over [0,T] (equal to the window value at the anchor because both variances increase)
gate_transfer_anchor.c0_formula: eta_*^2/(2 sup_[0,T]||Cov Y_t||): leading logarithmic rate of P(A_eps^c) (Borell-TIS upper bound, one-point Gaussian lower bound); any strictly smaller coefficient gives a usable bound
gate_transfer_anchor.interpolation_order_lower_bound_note: n > 2(c0+C_X)/c0 is necessary for the k=2 exponent to be negative

lemma_constants.formula: c_Y = min{(8 d sigma0^2)^-1, (32 d D0 T e^{2 gamma T})^-1}, c0 = c_Y eta_*^2
